name: muse
description: MUSE (Michael's Unified Strategy Engine) — a Jarvis-style personal AI operating system.

scripts.backend: npm run build:libs && npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.build:libs: npm run build:shared && npm run build:services
scripts.electron: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace=electron && npm run start --workspace=electron
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:libs && concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run dev"
